justification: Single-file runtime guard: strips OCR doubled-glyph running-header lines (SSeeccttiioonn 11 style) from provision text at read time in the for-property route. Complements the DQ-29 DB cleanup (845 headers already stripped in data); this catches the ~20 deferred rows and any future ingest with the same artifact. Conservative filter: only drops lines where collapsing consecutive duplicate letters shrinks the letter count by over 30 percent, and the existing never-blank-a-provision fallback is preserved.
functions: N/A - one pure helper (stripDoubledOcrLines) wired into the existing stripOcrHeaderPrefix; no signature changes.
values: N/A - no DB or API values read; pure string transformation on already-fetched provision text.
queries: N/A - no query changes; transformation applies after fetch.

break_it.scenario: A legitimate provision line that naturally contains tripled letters (e.g. a lot reference like IIII or a word with a doubled-letter run) gets dropped, silently losing regulatory text.
break_it.what_happens: A real line of provision text disappears from the rendered provision body.
break_it.how: Two-stage test: the line must match a three-pair doubled-glyph run AND collapsing consecutive duplicates must shrink its letters by over 30 percent - a normal English line with an incidental doubled fragment survives the ratio test; verified against the corpus where garbled lines are ~1.6 percent of characters and 0 rows retain doubling after removal.
break_it.repro: Pass a line like 'The committee will assess all applications' (doubled letters but low collapse ratio) through stripDoubledOcrLines and confirm it is kept; pass 'SSeeccttiioonn 11 IINNTTRROO' and confirm it is dropped.

break_it.scenario: The cleanup strips every line of a wholly-garbled provision, blanking regulatory text entirely.
break_it.what_happens: A provision would render empty instead of garbled.
break_it.how: The existing 'cleaned || text' fallback in stripOcrHeaderPrefix is unchanged - if cleaning empties the text, the original is returned, so a provision is never blanked.
break_it.repro: Feed a text consisting only of doubled-glyph lines and confirm the function returns the original text rather than an empty string.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - runtime transformation only, no data changes.
post_merge.secrets: No secrets involved in this change.
post_merge.other_repo: No other repository is affected by this change.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - load a City of Sydney DCP provision that previously showed doubled-glyph headers via /api/provisions/for-property and confirm headers are gone while body text is intact.
